text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From here on, the days of racing through 
the Twinkle Series with my partner 
Umamusume would begin. The name of the 
girl who walks alongside me is—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Nice to meetcha! I'm Mejiro Palmer!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I carry the Mejiro family name, but that's 
just a title. I think running freely in my 
own way and leaving a legacy under *my 
own* name is what matters most, you know?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Alright, enough with the stiff talk! 
Looking forward to working with you from 
now on, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, our challenge for the Twinkle 
Series with <chrname> began!
